injuries.detail: Dieng (finger) is questionable for Monday's game against the Raptors.
Murray-Boyles (concussion) is listed as probable for Monday's game against Milwaukee, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.
Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bucks, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.
Leonard (knee) could return in the next few weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Barrett has been diagnosed with a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
